abstract: The sensitivity to methotrexate (MTX) and mechanisms of the drug resistance of seven kinds of human choriocarcinoma cell lines were studied in vitro. The results were as follows. Each cell line of HCCM-5 , BeWo, IMa, and NUC-1 secreted more than 200ng/10(6) cells/48 hours of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG), whereas GCH-1, ENAMI-1, and SCH secreted less than 20ng/10(6) cells/48 hours. HCCM-5 cell line was the most sensitive to MTX judging from the inhibition of both 3H-thymidine uptake and cell growth in vitro. Each cell line of BeWo, IMa, and NUC-1 revealed sensitivity to 2 X 10(-8)M MTX, but such cell lines as GCH-1, ENAMI-1, and SCH showed resistance to MTX. The cell lines which revealed sensitivity to MTX incorporated more 3H-MTX and showed less intracellular dihydrofolate reductase activity than resistant cell lines.
abstract_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞株7種について、メトトレキサート(MTX)に対する感受性と薬剤耐性機序をin vitroで検討した。結果は以下のとおりである。HCCM-5、BeWo、IMa、NUC-1の各細胞株は、48時間で細胞10^6個あたり200ng以上のヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を分泌したが、GCH-1、ENAMI-1、SCHは20ng未満であった。HCCM-5株は、3H-チミジン取り込みと細胞増殖の抑制から判断して、in vitroで最もMTX感受性が高かった。BeWo、IMa、NUC-1の各株は2×10^-8MのMTXに感受性を示したが、GCH-1、ENAMI-1、SCHの各株はMTXに耐性を示した。MTX感受性を示した細胞株は、耐性株より多くの3H-MTXを取り込み、細胞内のジヒドロ葉酸還元酵素活性が低かった。
